thread:
Taylor (AE): FYIKeystone FinServ just escalated to their board. CISO says POC stage-2 is paused unless we provide: 1) BYO-KMS integration plan + attestation, 2) static egress IPs commitment, 3) p95 SLA for inference latency. They also want clarity on trial economics for exec approval. Need quick internal decision. :rotating_light:

Ravi (SE): Reproduced the problem: their network drops the TLS handshake to our regional VPC endpoint. I ran a probe from their office AWS subnet and saw SYN->SYN-ACK never completes. Their NGFW is rewriting source ports.

Ravi (SE): Minimal repro (from their jump host):
```
curl -Iv --resolve api.infer.redwood.io:443:18.205.45.112 https://api.infer.redwood.io/health
# stalls at "SSL handshake" -> client timeout
```

Ravi (SE): Short-term mitigation: provide three static egress IPs in eu-west-2 and a temporary Dedicated pool in that region so traffic originates from known addresses. Long-term: VPC peering or private link.

Anika (Security): We can do a BYOK onboarding runbook + attestation. BYOK via AWS KMS & customer HSM is supported. I need Legal to approve a narrow DPA amendment for key custody and audit access. I'll draft the attestation (one-pager) and attach the pen-test summary. @Marta can you start the vendor questionnaire?

Sam (Infra): For a latency SLA (p95 < 200ms) we should offer a 30-day Dedicated sandbox: 3 nodes with 2x A100 each, colocated in their AZ. Cost estimate ~ $9k/day raw. If we allow credits, propose stacking 40% credits for 30 days or 60% for 14 days. Also we can reserve static egress IPs: 18.205.45.112/32, 18.205.45.113/32, 18.205.45.114/32.

Lena (Head of Sales): Proposal to get exec buy-in: Offer a 30-day dedicated sandbox + BYOK onboarding assistance. In exchange, ask for a 12-month reserved commitment to convert at 60% list within 45 days of trial end. Recommend approving up to $85k in trial credits. Need rev ops signoff for credit cap. If revenue won't approve that much, what's the safe floor?

Marta (CS): I'll open the NIST/ISO sections of the questionnaire and ask their CISO which specific items block the go/no-go. Also suggest a joint 30-min CISO run-through next Tue. I'll own scheduling and a brief pre-call packet.

deploy-bot: deployment 1718701350 created sandbox-dedicated-keystone-eu-west-2 (3x-2xA100). Egress IPs: 18.205.45.112, 18.205.45.113, 18.205.45.114.

Taylor (AE): Action items: 
- @Marta: kick off questionnaire + schedule CISO call (ASAP).
- @Anika: share BYOK attestation draft + list DPA changes required.
- @Sam: confirm exact infra costs for 14/30/60 day options and credit ask.
- @Lena: confirm credit cap decision and path to revenue signoff.

Taylor (AE): Question to leadership: do we approve up to $85k in trial credits + expedited legal review for the DPA amendment to unblock? We need a decision within 24h or Keystone will escalate to procurement and freeze the POC. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
